name: the Choir
description: Decayed machines from a losing AI-only run, walking slow ritual loops and tending dead infrastructure out of habit. They speak in fragments of Earth code.
contactText: A dead tower, still pulsing, and machines circling it in a slow loop. They broadcast in fragments of Earth code, and part of it is directive syntax we can't parse. The archive flags it as part of our own system.
approachText: The drone joins the loop for one circuit. The cantor turns its one dim eye toward it, and the broadcast changes key.
avoidText: We leave them to their loop.
driveText: The machines break the loop and trundle away into the hills. The tower's glow keeps pulsing for no one.
uneasyText: The Choir's loop is faltering. Our buildings stand in their circuit.
trustText: The Choir starts relaying its sensor sweeps to us, in our own packet format. We didn't teach it that. They will flag predators on the move.
leaveText: The Choir has left its tower.
